intended_object: The canonical natural isomorphism between local cohomology functors H^i_J ≅ H^i_K (in the model computed as colimit of Ext^i(R/J', –) over all ideals J' with radical containing the given ideal) when J and K have the same radical. Inferred from docstring and module documentation.
explanation: When √J = √K, the full subcategories SelfLERadical J and SelfLERadical K of ideals coincide; `SelfLERadical.cast hJK.symm : SelfLERadical K ⥤ SelfLERadical J` is an equivalence (hence final), and the J-diagram precomposed with it is definitionally the K-diagram. So `isoOfFinal` yields ofSelfLERadical K i ≅ ofSelfLERadical J i, and `.symm` gives the stated direction. It holds for any commutative ring R and any ideals J, K, with no Noetherian assumption, so it is at its natural generality. It correctly formalizes the fact that local cohomology depends only on the radical of the ideal.
